name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: Ready-made add-ons that teach Claude to act like a specialist for a specific job — sales, legal, finance, HR — connecting it to the tools that role already uses, like Slack, Jira, or HubSpot.
buyer: An operations consultant who helps mid-size companies adopt AI tools and wants a fast, credible starting point instead of building integrations from scratch for every client.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm customizes the 'legal' plugin for a client's specific contract templates and terminology, then charges for the implementation.
An agency offers 'Claude for Sales Teams' as a packaged rollout service, wiring up a client's CRM and Slack via the sales plugin.
An internal ops team at a mid-size company customizes the finance plugin to match their close process and chart of accounts, saving hours per month.

money_ideas.idea: Charge a flat implementation fee to customize and deploy a plugin for a specific client's tools and terminology.
Offer ongoing managed support/updates for a company's customized plugin set.

steal_this: Pick one plugin (e.g. customer-support), customize it this weekend for a specific local business's actual tools and tone, and pitch it to them as a done-for-you AI setup.
